name: Real-Time Metaball Ray Casting with Fragment Lists
aliases: Fragment List Based Metaball Ray Casting
definition: A real-time ray casting method for rendering particle-based medium representations (metaballs) that builds per-pixel lists of relevant metaballs, incrementally constructs a piecewise polynomial approximation of summed densities along rays, and finds intersections with the isosurface.
summary: Real-Time Metaball Ray Casting with Fragment Lists is a single-pass GPU method that replaces depth peeling with per-pixel fragment lists to efficiently render millions of metaballs by incrementally constructing polynomial density approximations along rays.
